$comment: Waiting for components that haven't landed: code-block-trace (Trace), code-block-markdown (a Markdown renderer for Ember, upstream's Streamdown). The unit that lands each one ports its examples onto the Code Block page and maps them here.

code-block-demo.reason: Only highlighted tokens differ: the reference app screenshots before Shiki has highlighted (it is ready once its fonts are), and Joinery colours tokens with GitHub's high-contrast themes, which meet WCAG AA where upstream's github-light does not. Upstream's code names a real model, and Joinery's sources name none, so its placeholder (of the same length, so the layout is the same) differs in those characters.
